hypothesis: At the SAME two555 synthetic fixtures, source four-raw relative-periodic mechanical states exist including wheel omega, gas memory, steering joint/rates and lagged wheel offsets. Constant gas/steer, no braking in periodic-state branch. This is a new discrete shooting representation, not more iterations of555 continuous equilibrium.
representation: Mechanical full state modulo SE(2), including mass/inertia, wheel headings/friction, joints/rates, omega/gas, yaw/angular momentum, offsets/levers and steering memory. Global roads are not SE(2) invariant: road tile identities are logged, all accepted validations require original map footprint/friction. Synthetic fixture, not reachable native state.

solve.variables: beta,delta,gas, four wheel omega; speed and initial yaw=v*k fixed from same555fixture
solve.solver_gate: velocity body-frame <=1e-4m/s, yaw<=1e-5rad/s, wheel omega<=1e-4rad/s; independently verify ALL signature fields after float32 actions; normalized maximum<=1. No solver_success substitution.

validation.perturbation: one deterministic vx +=1e-3m/s in body coordinates and rear wheel3 omega +=1e-2rad/s, same synthetic pose; no multiple perturbation search
validation.finite_stability: report initial/final/max normalized deviation from matched unperturbed period phases; contraction is diagnostic, not a necessary physical gate or asymptotic stability proof
validation.safety: accepted validation: footprint>=.50, raw force<=1.059, hull/all wheels<100, clipping<=10% cumulatively from fixture validation start, position error to original seed path<=3m; diagnostic speed reference is each synthetic branch target, overspeed<=4.85. Also log old551 reference overspeed separately; this is NOT an old551 compliant participant controller.

transition.trigger: Both original fixtures pass independent four-raw mechanical fullstate and safety; exact multi-period safety failures are logged separately, not evidence that the periodic state does not exist. Minimum transition may still run in fresh initial fixture if periodic existence passes; perturbed stability is diagnostic.
transition.target: Only next seed station after first555fixture, same speed as source fixture, its existing signed curvature. Solve once using same budget/parameterization; no alternate target.
transition.controls: 4 holds x steer and signed pedal, continuous solver then float32 independent validation; negative pedal is brake, positive gas. No PP/reference steering. One initial linear command interpolation; max_nfev60/max residual calls1000.
transition.endpoint: ALL mechanical signature normalized residual<=1 using transition tolerances: velocity .15m/s,yaw .05,angular momentum I*.05,joints .02,rates .15,omega .5,gas .02,headings .02,offsets .15; levers/constants/friction unchanged; pose angle free moduloSE2.
transition.after: If endpoint+physical safety pass, three additional constant-target holds must stay safe and within same endpoint tolerances. No cold/carry/native or lap-time claim.

stop: Budget/deadline/model body domain -> stop with checkpoint; failure of both original periodic gates -> no transition. No parameter/speed/curvature sweep or rerun. Finite solver failure is not physical impossibility. Unsafe solver trials are forecasts only, counted and retained, never accepted validation.
